formatDescription: The Binary Alignment Index file is a companion file that acts as a table of contents for the Binary Alignment Map file (.bam). .bai files provide virtual file offsets that allow genome viewers to jump instantly to a specific genomic coordinate without scanning the entire Binary Alignment Map file.
formatNote:
Sequence Alignment/Map Format Specification - https://samtools.github.io/hts-specs/SAMv1.pdf
What are BAM and BAI files? - https://switzerlandomics.ch/learn/bam-and-bai-format/
